config.reward: visible score difference only, constant scale for optimizer
config.policy: learned categorical over fixed twelve command groups, sampled
config.resume_semantics: optimizer and policy RNG restored; emulator episodes restart from boot
config.evaluation_policy: same fixed grouped categorical policy, sampled
